description: This Java source file defines the DrugEditor class, a property editor for the Drug object in the OpenMRS platform. It enables serialization/deserialization of Drug instances to and from strings, allowing integration with web forms and other mediums, with support for lookup by ID and UUID.

classes.name: DrugEditor
classes.description: A property editor that handles serialization and deserialization of Drug objects, extending OpenmrsPropertyEditor.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Drug object by its integer ID using the context's concept service.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Drug object by its UUID string using the context's concept service.
